title: How to send Ethereum from Luno to Trust wallet Forsage
description:
How to Register in Forsage
 ✅install Trust Wallet on your phone from Google play store or Matamask on your Laptop/pc
 ✅ After installation of the trust wallet app. 
✅Create an account 
✅Then fund your Ethereum wallet with 0.05Eth. 
 ✅ From your Trust wallet Go to DApps and paste this link given to you:https://forsage.io/i/477trm/ on the search or Website URL space 
✅ Then Load it...... It will take you to the website. 
✅ Click on join now 
✅ Then click the Green Button that shows Automatically Login/Registration 
✅ Click Confirm on the next page if the Upline ID ( 199823) is correct ✅Approve the transaction Congratulations, your Registration is Successful. How to Login
 ✅ Go to DApps on your Trust Wallet and paste  (https://forsage.io/i/477trm ) the space for search or URL and click enter.
 ✅ On the next page, click login

textual.observation: The description instructs viewers to fund an Ethereum wallet with 0.05Eth, navigate to a Forsage referral URL, verify an Upline ID, and approve a transaction to complete registration.

evidence.quote: Then fund your Ethereum wallet with 0.05Eth.
From your Trust wallet Go to DApps and paste this link given to you:https://forsage.io/i/477trm/ on the search or Website URL space
Click Confirm on the next page if the Upline ID ( 199823) is correct
Approve the transaction Congratulations, your Registration is Successful.

textual.context: The material is presented as procedural registration instructions. The supplied records do not state why the payment, Upline ID, or transaction approval is required beyond registration, and do not establish whether this is promotion or independent discussion.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated sequence connects funding a wallet, using a specified referral-style URL and Upline ID, and approving an Ethereum transaction to obtain registration; the payment and referral relationship may require later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish the transaction recipient, the amount actually transferred, the destination's identity or operation, any returns or rewards, or an outcome for viewers.

textual_context_notes.observation: The ASR describes a transfer from a Luno account to a Trust Wallet and recommends two-factor authentication for the Luno account.

evidence.quote: what I'm going to show you today is how to send aetherium from Luna to trust wallets.
another thing that I would highly recommend is activating or enabling your two-factor authentication

textual_context_notes.observation: The ASR says the transfer was checked and shown as received in the wallet.

evidence.quote: it shows they're that I have received the other EM

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because its accompanying description turns a wallet-transfer demonstration into instructions for entering Forsage: viewers are told to fund a wallet with 0.05 ETH, open a Forsage referral URL, check an upline ID, and approve the registration transaction. The video supplies the transfer steps for that funding path. A separate SEC complaint describes the named program as selling slots in a recruitment-dependent matrix; no completed Forsage payment is shown in the sampled frames.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits this funded Forsage registration pathway when read with the separately cited SEC complaint. The video description supplies the 0.05 ETH funding step, referral URL, upline ID, and transaction approval; the complaint supplies the program-level slot purchase and upline/downline payment mechanism. The screen demonstration alone is a wallet transfer and does not display the complete matrix.

evidence.observation: The speaker demonstrates selecting an ETH amount, confirming the transaction, and entering the Luno PIN.

evidence.observation: The description instructs viewers to prepare 0.05 ETH as part of the named Forsage registration process.

evidence.observation: The Trust Wallet Ethereum screen visibly shows a received transaction of +0.000552 ETH alongside earlier sent transactions.
The description directs viewers to the named Forsage referral URL after funding their wallet.
The description instructs viewers to verify a specified upline ID in the Forsage registration flow.
The description tells viewers to approve a registration transaction.
